case_name: Sangita Vilas Ingle v State of Maharashtra and others
facts: The appellant is aggrieved by the summary dismissal of the Criminal Writ Petition No.53 of 2013 filed by her.
The judgment dated 17th June, 2013 expressed in cryptic words reads as follows:-
The prayers made in the writ petition are as follows:
Having regard to the prayers extracted above, the High Court was not justified in dismissing the writ petition only on the ground that some disputed questions of fact were involved.
Accordingly, we allow the appeal and set aside the impugned judgment.
issues: Whether the High Court was justified in dismissing the writ petition
What remedy is available to the petitioner
petitioner_arguments: The writ petition requires to be considered on merits.
The High Court was not justified in dismissing the writ petition only on the ground that some disputed questions of fact were involved.
court_reasoning: We allow the appeal and set aside the impugned judgment.

The writ petition is remanded to the High Court and we request the High Court to take up the writ petition expeditiously, consider and dispose of the same on merits, preferably within a period of one year.
holding: Writ petition is remanded to the High Court
cases_cited: Sangita Vilas Ingle v State of Maharashtra
